projects.title: Pervaya Tsifra
projects.summary: A full identity for a digital services company: mark, type system, mascot, print and the site it all had to live on.
body: Positioning, mark, type system, colour, mascot and the printed set were decided together rather than handed between three people.
The brand shipped: the live site is the proof, not a mockup.

projects.title: Small Puppet Theatre
projects.summary: A touring puppet theatre with no building of its own — so the site had to be the building: repertoire, schedule, actors, and a way to book the troupe.
body: Six shows, each with an age rating, a running time and a source — a parent decides in one screen whether it fits a one-year-old or a seven-year-old.
The theatre tours. The strongest page is not the repertoire but the one that says invite the theatre to you: four steps and one phone number.

projects.title: MTS Money
projects.summary: 3D illustration for fintech products across digital and marketing platforms — expressive volume kept inside a minimal, UI-friendly system.
body: Designed high-quality 3D illustrations for fintech products across digital and marketing platforms, holding one visual style across the whole set.
Visual metaphors for a wide range of services — banking features, office access, travel bookings, mobility.
Scenes built and rendered in Cinema 4D with Redshift.

projects.title: 2x2 TV Channel
projects.summary: Two seasonal idents for the 2x2 TV channel — one built on speed, one on light.
body: Summer ident: a high-speed night drive. A sports car races the highway with a stylised logo set into its hood; flowing smoke carries the speed.
Winter ident: light and atmosphere. Headlights throw the 2x2 logo onto a wall — dramatic lighting, raw urban texture, a moody doomer tone.

projects.title: Honor
projects.role: Execution to the agency storyboard and art
projects.summary: Two product films — Honor X8c and Honor Pad 10 — built on clean geometry, refined materials and precise camera work.
body: Honor X8c — a brand film exploring the product through clean geometry and refined materials. Slim silhouette, camera system, surface detail. Role: modelling, shading, fluid simulations, photorealistic rendering, compositing.

Honor Pad 10 — a fast product film on the key features. Macro shots on design, display and material; soft controlled light and precise animation. Role: lookdev, lighting, camera animation, compositing, final rendering.

projects.title: Interactive Installations
projects.summary: Around twenty audiovisual experiments on interactive and generative installation content: voice input, motion tracking, audio-driven sync.
body: In autumn 2021 I ran a series of audiovisual experiments on interactive and generative installation content. It ended at around twenty pieces, each examining a different interaction method — voice input, motion tracking, audio-driven synchronisation.

Three workstations: an MSI Creator for real-time visuals in Notch VFX, a laptop generating audio in Ableton Live, and an HP NUC running TouchDesigner for input and system integration. Everything spoke OSC.
